items.title: CSS-Tricks has a new owner
items.blurb: Yes, I've got the keys to the castle, so to speak. And, even after 12 years of working on the site, I'll admit I'm a little overwhelmed and nervous about that.

items.title: BrowserCode: a browser-based coding playground, powered by WebAssembly
items.blurb: BrowserCode is a development environment that runs entirely client-side, where you can fast prototype and share your running projects instantly.
